name: CovenantMonitoring
description: A covenant test result record created by SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core) in PH-022 (JRN-007) for each covenant tested on each test date. One record per covenant per test event — immutable once compliance_status is set. A compliance_status = breached triggers EVT-039 (CovenantBreachDetected). Records accumulate over the loan term providing a full covenant compliance audit trail.

fields.name: covenant_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: dscr_min | leverage_max | interest_cover_min | tangible_net_worth_min | other. Must match a covenant in FacilityAgreement.covenants.

fields.name: target_value
fields.validation_rule: Required. Decimal, 4 dp. Contractually agreed threshold from FacilityAgreement.covenants.

fields.name: actual_value
fields.validation_rule: Required. Decimal, 4 dp. Borrower-reported or bank-calculated actual covenant metric value.

fields.name: compliance_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: compliant | breached | waived | not_yet_tested. Transitions to 'waived' only via formal committee waiver — not by overwriting original record.

fields.name: review_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Date the covenant test was performed.

fields.name: test_period_end_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Financial period end date to which actual_value relates.

relationships.description: CovenantMonitoring belongs to one LoanAccount. Multiple test records accumulate over the loan term.

design_decisions.decision: One immutable CovenantMonitoring record per covenant per test date — never overwritten.
design_decisions.rationale: Covenant test results are a regulated audit trail. Overwriting records would destroy IFRS 9 impairment evidence and BBRS/PRA audit trail. Waiver creates a new record, not an update.
